name: IC Interface USB — 5V, USB, UART/serial — SSOP
description: Surface-mount 5V USB interface ICs supporting UART/serial functionality in SSOP footprints such as SSOP-28_5.3x10.2mm_P0.65mm.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 5V USB to UART/serial interface IC.
Use when an SMD SSOP footprint (such as SSOP-28_5.3x10.2mm_P0.65mm) is needed.
Choose between CY7C65213-28PVXI or CY7C65213A-28PVXI Tier A components.
avoid_when: Avoid if the design requires a package family other than SSOP.
Do not use when through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
Avoid if interface requirements differ from 5V, USB, or UART/serial.
